# DEXTRA

> An Even G2 smart-glasses app plus a Telegram business bot. Agree something out loud; the glasses turn it into a short note that the other person confirms in their own Telegram chat; then both people tick items off and get due-date reminders. Built for "Heads Up: Even Realities Hackathon" (Even Realities × TVM Ventures × Daos Hub), tracks 01 Messaging & News and 04 AI Assistants & Work.

## Try it
- Bot: https://t.me/DextraAgreeBot
- Live server health: https://dextra-qfz7.onrender.com/health
- No glasses or API keys needed: `git clone https://github.com/egbujor-emmanuel/dextra && cd dextra && npm install && npm run try` (official Even simulator against the live server)

## How it works
1. The phone keeps the last 45 s of glasses-mic audio in memory only.
2. Hold to lock: the server transcribes (Deepgram), works out who said each line (voice separation → voice pitch → LLM turn guess), and an LLM (free Groq tier, gpt-oss-120b) proposes commitments, each with a verbatim quote.
3. Deterministic code keeps a commitment only if its quote is in what that speaker said, any amount was spoken, and it has no links; repeats are merged.
4. One tap sends it as the wearer into the Telegram chat with the other person (business connection).
5. The other person confirms or changes it. Confirmed records get a SHA-256 fingerprint.
6. Both get tap-when-done buttons (or a shared Telegram checklist when the wearer has Premium) and reminders the day before, on the day, and when overdue.

## Proof
- 112 automated tests (core, glasses, server); typecheck clean
- Extraction eval: 12 conversations, 17 commitments, precision 1.00, recall 0.94, 0 invented commitments reached the lens
- 29 safety invariants, each mapped to a test: THREAT_MODEL.md
- Verified live with two real Telegram accounts: pair → lock → send → confirm → tick → fulfilled
